items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: and then I was at the Riverboat again with Cab and Cab with Ella Fitzgerald and Earl Hines, me and Bud Johnson and a little boy named Don something, saxophone player.

ctx.x: And then 1965 was -- I was freelancing most of that time. We went in the Riverboat Room -- and then 1966 with -- oh, I did some things at the City Center, some musicals at the City, you know, the City Center, and then I was at the Riverboat with Cab Calloway, and then I was at the Riverboat again with Cab and Cab with Ella Fitzgerald and Earl Hines, me and Bud Johnson and a little boy named Don something, saxophone player.
1967 I went to Canada with Willie Lion Smith. In fact, Willie --
